author: Copilot
body:
Theme file watching is started in ThemeRegistry.init(), but CustomThemeLoader.startWatching() fails when themes.json doesn’t exist yet (open() returns -1). Since initializeDefaultThemesIfNeeded() may create the file after this, hot-reload won’t work on first run. Consider ensuring themes.json exists before starting the watcher, or watch the directory and (re)attach the watcher after initialization/rename events.
```suggestion
        // Ensure themes.json exists and load themes before starting the watcher
        initializeDefaultThemesIfNeeded()
```

author: Copilot
body:
The doc comment says custom themes are loaded from "~/.config/bat-mon/themes.json", but the implementation uses ~/Library/Application Support/BatMon/themes.json. Please update the comment to match the actual path (and keep it consistent with the README).
```suggestion
/// Combines hardcoded themes with user-configurable themes from ~/Library/Application Support/BatMon/themes.json
```

author: Copilot
body: The UI hint "(affects battery & status colors)" is shown when usesFullThemePalette is false, but MenuBarView applies theme.background/backgroundSecondary/etc for native/rich/minimal too. Either adjust usesFullThemePalette (and related copy) to reflect actual behavior, or stop applying full palette colors for those layouts so the copy is accurate.

author: Copilot
body: updateWidgetData() calls WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines() on every battery characteristic update, which can be very frequent and may exceed WidgetKit refresh limits. Consider throttling/debouncing these reloads (and only writing/reloading when values actually change).

author: Copilot
body:
CustomThemeLoader’s header comment says themes are managed at "~/.config/bat-mon/themes.json", but configDirectory/themesFilePath clearly point to Application Support/BatMon/themes.json. Update the comment to avoid sending users to the wrong location.
```suggestion
/// Handles loading, saving, and managing custom themes from Application Support/BatMon/themes.json
```

author: Copilot
body: startWatching() watches the themes.json file descriptor directly; since saves are done with .atomic, the file is typically replaced via rename, which can invalidate the watched FD. After .rename/.delete events, you likely need to stopWatching() and re-open the FD (or watch the containing directory instead) to keep hot-reload working reliably.

author: Copilot
body: The Launch at Login toggle now binds to LaunchAtLogin.isEnabled, but AppSettings.launchAtLogin is still persisted and no longer reflects the UI/system state. This can lead to stale settings and confusing migrations. Either remove launchAtLogin from AppSettings, or keep it in sync (e.g., set it when toggled and apply it on startup).

author: Copilot
body: PreferencesManager.saveSettings() calls WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines() on every settings change (including slider drags), which can be expensive and may hit WidgetKit rate limits. Consider debouncing reloads and/or only reloading when widget-relevant settings change (and prefer reloadTimelines(ofKind:) when possible).

author: Copilot
body: This PR description says "non-widget changes only", but WidgetKit is now imported and widget-specific keys/timeline reloads are introduced here. Either update the PR description/scope or move these widget sync changes to a dedicated widget PR to keep review surface area manageable.

author: Copilot
body: ConnectionState.isBluetoothUnavailable relies on substring matching against the .failed(String) message ("contains('bluetooth')"), which is brittle and can break UI behavior if copy changes. Consider representing Bluetooth availability explicitly (separate state/case or a structured error) and drive UI off that instead of string inspection.
